subject: Nimbus onboarding: SDK + auth routing and embeddings/reranker strategy
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Shah <priya@nimbus-analytics.com>, Ethan Brooks <ethan@nimbletech.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Mar 2028 15:22:00 +0000
Subject: Nimbus onboarding: SDK + auth routing and embeddings/reranker strategy

Hi Priya, Ethan — great call this morning. Recap + proposed next steps so we have an actionable plan for the pilot integration: 

Summary of decisions from call:
- Primary integration will use server-to-server flow for model calls (no user-level OAuth for now).
- Nimbus will evaluate embeddings for semantic search + a lightweight reranker for top-N reordering.
- SDK bootstrapping: Nimbus will try our Node SDK first; fallback to direct REST for latency-sensitive paths.
- Auth approach: prefer service-account JWTs with short-lived tokens (recommended) vs long-lived API keys.

Open questions we flagged on the call:
1) Do you have an SRE contact to accept inbound IPs / routing?
2) Expected volume pattern (qps, average tokens per request) so we can suggest batching/throughput config.
3) Any compliance constraints around key storage / rotation frequency?

Proposed immediate next steps (owner / ETA):
- Jordan: share SDK bootstrap + sample routing config (today) -> attached redwood_sdk_bootstrap.md
- Ben: architecture sketch + recommended auth matrix (service account vs API key) (Wed EOD) -> attached nimbus_mvp_arch.png
- Priya/Ethan: provide QPS estimate and SRE contact (by Wed)
- Marissa: prepare commercial framework + provisional PO terms for pilot (Thu) -> attached proposed_mup_terms-v1.pdf

Please confirm or flag changes. If that looks good, I’ll open a HubSpot task (NA-3492) and we’ll schedule a 45m technical handoff next week.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0198

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 13 Mar 2028 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Nimbus onboarding: SDK + auth routing and embeddings/reranker strategy

Thanks Jordan — helpful recap. Quick answers: 

1) SRE contact: Ethan will be the point for inbound rules and routing (ethan@nimbletech.io).
2) QPS: for pilot expect ~5–8 qps peak, mostly small prompts (avg ~80 tokens), occasional batch jobs for nightly reindexing (~120k tokens total).
3) Compliance: we need key material to live in our HashiVault instance; rotation every 30 days preferred, audit logging required.

Couple of asks from our side:
- Can Redwood support issuing short-lived tokens via a JWKS + token exchange flow so we never store long-lived secrets in Nimbus?
- For embeddings, we’d like guidance on vector dimensionality and reranker latency tradeoffs.

We’re ready for the technical handoff — Thu or Fri next week works.

Priya Shah
Head of Integrations | Nimbus Analytics
priya@nimbus-analytics.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Shah <priya@nimbus-analytics.com>, Ethan Brooks <ethan@nimbletech.io>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 13 Mar 2028 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Nimbus onboarding: SDK + auth routing and embeddings/reranker strategy

Priya — short answers inline, and a suggested auth matrix attached. Key points: 

- Token exchange / short-lived flow: yes — we support an OAuth2-compatible token-exchange for service accounts (JWT assertion -> short-lived bearer token). That lets you keep private keys in Vault and request ephemeral tokens from Redwood.
- If you want to avoid any long-lived secrets on Nimbus side, use: service account private key (vaulted) -> signed JWT assertion -> /oauth/token exchanger -> short-lived bearer (15m-1h TTL).
- For workloads that call from client browsers/mobile, we recommend a separate frontend token gating flow (not part of pilot).

Embedding guidance:
- Default 1024-d for high-quality semantic search; 512-d if you need lower storage/throughput and can accept slight drop in nuance.
- For reranking: 1) generate top-50 by vector search, 2) apply a lightweight cross-encoder or scoring reranker — aim for <120ms p95 for interactive features.

Attachments: ben_auth_matrix.pdf (auth decision matrix), nimbus_mvp_arch.png (annotated).

I’ll put together a recommended rotation cadence: we generally recommend automated rotation via your Vault -> sign-and-exchange flow daily for key usage (rotate private keys monthly). I’ll have a draft rotation schedule by Wed EOD.

- Ben
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

Priya — we can get the commercial pilot terms ready. A couple notes on billing/auth implications: 

- For the pilot, we’ll enable a dedicated API key scope for usage tracking but won’t require it for server-side JWT flow. The dedicated tracking key helps with billing attribution to the pilot deal (NA-3492).
- If Nimbus requires that Redwood not hold any long-lived keys, we can still support that via the JWT exchange + HubSpot/PO referencing for invoicing.
- I'll circulate a one-page SOW by Thu that references the rotation requirements and audit log delivery schedule.

Scheduling: Jordan — suggest technical handoff Thurs 16:00 PT (45m). Priya/Ethan — does that still work?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole

marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Nimbus onboarding: SDK + auth routing and embeddings/reranker strategy

Thanks — confirmed for Thu 16:00 PT. A couple quick operational notes from my side: 

- We run Vault (HashiCorp) automated rotations today; we’ll provision a service account private key into Vault and we can automate the JWT assertion issuance.
- Rotation cadence: we prefer to rotate private keys monthly. For the pilot, we can start with monthly rotation while we evaluate automated daily signing via Vault for assertions.
- One ask: can Redwood support a webhook that logs token exchanges (metadata only: subject, iat, exp, request id) to a secure S3 bucket for our audit pipeline?

I'll bring a sample of our embedding dataset to the call. Looking forward to the handoff.

Ethan
Lead SRE | NimbleTech (vendor partner to Nimbus)
ethan@nimbletech.io
